notes: Employees by region from the Sustainability Report 2026 (2025 column; the quoted rows also show 2023 and 2024). The Korea row is the only single-country figure; the other regions are Samsung's own groupings (Asia covers Southeast Asia, Southwest Asia, China and Japan) and no country list is given, so countries is null for them. Regional rows sum to the company total of 259,149; they exclude 64,216 non-Samsung Electronics workers reported separately. Samsung says it owns 221 manufacturing sites, sales offices, R&D centers and design centers in total as of the end of 2025 (Sustainability Report 2026), but no per-country site count. The Business Report names major production sites by product: smartphones at Gumi (plus Vietnam, India and Brazil) and memory at Hwaseong, Pyeongtaek and other Korean sites plus China. Sites come from the FY2025 Business Report (company-hosted English translation of the DART filing), except the Pyeongtaek Line 2 description, which only the FY2024 Business Report's company history carries; the Taylor, Texas foundry is recorded only as the 2021 investment announcement the report describes. Taxes: Samsung publishes the regional split of taxes and public duties (2025: Korea 52.6%, Americas and Europe 21.2%, Asia 25.3%, others 0.9% of KRW 8.9 trillion); those tax regions are a different grouping from the employee regions and are listed as separate rows. No U.S. state data.
